thag3.6:1.1: Ye cittakathī bahussutā samaṇā Pāṭaliputtavāsino tes' aññataro 'yam āyuvā dvāre tiṭṭhati Khujjasobhito. || ||
thag3.6:2.1: ye cittakathī bahussutā samaṇā Pāṭaliputtavāsino tes' aññataro 'yam āyuvā dvāre tiṭṭhati māluterito. || ||
thag3.6:3.1: suyuddhena suyiṭṭhena saṃgāmavijayena ca brahmacariyānuciṇṇena evāyaṃ sukham edhati. || || Khujjasobhito thero.
